decision_conditions: The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy and Sustainability Statement (Issue 2) prepared by HTA Design LLP and dated 15 November 2021. Prior to first occupation of the relevant phase, phase-specific as-built Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs accompanied by the necessary calculations to adjust for the carbon factors in SAP10 shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as thedevelopment is in existence.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
